The '''Ratit system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the regions known as the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was home to the [[Species/Legends|creatures]] known as [[Ratitan whisperfly|Ratitan whisperflies]].<ref name="SoP" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ratit system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square M-14.<ref name="TEA" />
